## Temporary — delete after the pipeline is proven

Stands in for app.html so the render pipeline can be exercised without a browser, a login, or an upload.

It borrows the newest photo any account has already uploaded — or `workflows/selftest-kitchen.jpg` from the repo when there is none — inserts a fresh `renders` row, posts **the exact payload app.html posts**, then reads the row back. `Verdict` is the node to read.

**It spends real money.** One credit off the test account and one BFL Kontext call per run. `Grant Test Credits` sets the balance to 3 only when the account has none and no active subscription — without it the pipeline answers 402 and the run teaches nothing about BFL.

`Fire Render Webhook` continues on error on purpose: a 402 or 500 must still reach `Read Result Row`, because what the row says is the actual finding.
